source.description: One reviewed eight-panel graphite-and-colored-pencil contact sheet cropped into seven cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one centered front-view pair of pouty lips with a soft cupid's bow, one continuous mouth seam, one narrow inner opening, restrained upper- and lower-lip crease groups, two oval open-paper highlights plus one broken center paper glow, light philtrum anchors, tactile graphite, restrained dusty-rose color, and no surrounding face, teeth, lettering, labels, arrows, numbers, signature, or watermark.

process_strategy: Use eight cumulative stages so the pale lip map, rough silhouette, refined cupid's bow and corners, mouth opening and lip planes, crease and highlight routes, graphite value, restrained color, and final reinforcement each receive a distinct visible job. Reserve the inner opening, two oval highlights, and broken center glow before dark contours so no keeper line or shaded area must be removed later.

final_elements.name: pale mouth axis lip envelopes corner opening highlight and philtrum construction
final_elements.description: Pale graphite guides establish one horizontal mouth axis, two corners, upper and lower lip envelopes, the cupid's-bow center, one narrow inner-opening route, two highlight reserves, and light philtrum anchors.

final_elements.name: rough upper and lower lip silhouette with continuous mouth seam
final_elements.description: A loose handmade contour wraps one upper lip and one fuller lower lip around one continuous mouth seam, with the page-left corner lifted slightly higher for a readable pout.

final_elements.name: refined cupid's bow asymmetric corners and lower-lip edge
final_elements.description: A soft M-shaped cupid's bow, two distinct corners, the slightly lifted page-left corner, and a clean rounded lower-lip edge clarify the front-view anatomy without polished line art.

final_elements.name: narrow inner opening upper and lower lip plane breaks
final_elements.description: One narrow negative opening sits between the established lips, with simple plane-break curves that show the upper lip turning inward and the lower lip rolling outward.

final_elements.name: upper and lower crease groups two oval highlights broken center glow and philtrum accents
final_elements.description: Restrained upper- and lower-lip crease groups, two oval open-paper highlight shapes, one broken center paper glow, and two light philtrum accents add texture while preserving the main silhouette.

final_elements.name: directional graphite hatching and soft mouth-corner values
final_elements.description: Tactile graphite hatching follows the lip planes, deepens the existing mouth opening and corners, and keeps the center of the lower lip lighter.

final_elements.name: restrained dusty-rose and muted-plum colored-pencil accents
final_elements.description: Dusty rose lightly warms both lips and muted plum deepens the established opening and corners while graphite grain and both paper highlights remain visible.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: narrow inner opening upper and lower lip plane breaks
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The upper and lower lip shading stops at the reserved mouth opening, and no tooth, tongue, or completed hatch mark is drawn beneath that negative shape.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: upper and lower crease groups two oval highlights broken center glow and philtrum accents
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: Graphite hatching and colored pencil stop around the two oval highlight reserves and broken center paper glow, while crease groups remain inside the established lip contours.

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthens selected established contours, deepens the existing graphite and colored-pencil values, clarifies the same two oval highlights and broken center glow, and softens distracting pale guides without changing the lip silhouette, opening, crease routes, palette, or composition.

rejection_checks: Keep one front-view pair of lips, one centered pose, one crop, and one scale in all eight panels.

Keep one continuous mouth seam, one narrow inner opening, the established upper- and lower-lip crease groups, two oval highlights, one broken center glow, and two philtrum accents after those elements appear.
The cupid's bow, corner positions, mouth width, lower-lip fullness, and opening thickness may not drift between panels.
The inner opening must occupy only its reserved route, and graphite and colored pencil must stop around both highlight reserves.
Do not add teeth, tongue, nose, full face, makeup tools, lettering, labels, arrows, numbers, signature, watermark, decorative border, or glossy lipstick rendering.
The final panel may not introduce a contour, opening, corner change, crease, philtrum mark, highlight, hatch route, shadow shape, or color area.
The finish must look like tactile graphite and restrained colored pencil on warm paper, not a beauty ad, photoreal mouth, glossy digital painting, polished AI art, or rasterized vector drawing.
